resources.string: Clone a profile to make your own: change its levers and timings, then use it by day or at night.
The baseline. Proves what the phone does on its own, and is the comparison in every report.
Deep idle within about 10 minutes of a still, screen-off phone instead of an hour. The safe default.
For a phone carried while moving: on a commute or a walk. Motion no longer starts the wait over, so deep idle holds in a pocket.
For the long unplugged, screen-off stretch in the night window. The longest gaps between maintenance windows.
Upstream EnforceDoze\'s behaviour, kept for parity: deep idle the moment the screen turns off.
For travel, low battery or a long day away from a charger. Never recommended automatically.
Your own profile, saved on this phone.
Nothing visible: once idle, messages behave as on stock, they just get there sooner.
Step counting on the phone pauses while the screen is off; lift-to-wake and pocket detection may stop.
Normal-priority messages can wait up to 2 hours early in the night, longer later. Alarm clocks and high-priority messages are not delayed.
Normal-priority messages are delayed from the first minute of screen off.
The longest message delays: only allowlisted apps and high-priority messages get through promptly.
Step counting pauses while the screen is off.
Messages can wait up to 2 h early in the night.
Messages wait from the first minute of screen off.
Normal-priority messages are delayed from the first minute of screen off.
Normal-priority messages are delayed from %1$s after screen off.
Only apps marked keep get through promptly.
Normal-priority messages can wait up to %1$s in a deep-idle window.
Normal-priority messages can wait %1$s in the first deep-idle window, longer later.
Step counting pauses while the screen is off.
Every sensor is off while the screen is off, so step counting, lift-to-wake and rotation stop.
The phone\'s own values appear here once onboarding has read them.
Doze timing is off: this profile leaves every timing at the phone\'s own value.
How long the phone waits after screen off before it starts checking it is still.
How long it then watches for motion before the motion check.
The longest the motion check may take.
The longest wait for a location fix, on phones that still take one before deep idle.
The first wait again after the phone was moved, used in its place.
How long after screen off light idle starts.
The length of the first deep-idle window.
How much each later deep-idle window grows.
The longest a deep-idle window can get.
How long an app stays allowed after an SMS, MMS or notification. Never below the phone\'s own value.
One UI\'s own setting: its effect on this phone is unknown.
Not one of EnforceDoze\'s timings: written as it is.
Not on this phone: skipped, so this profile is partly applied.
This profile is gone. It may have been deleted.
Puts the phone straight into deep idle at screen off, skipping the wait.
Keeps deep idle at the lock screen and lets go when you unlock.
All sensors off also stops step counting, lift-to-wake and rotation while the screen is off.
Turn on Doze timing to write these.
Not below the phone\'s own %1$s: SMS, MMS and notification exemptions depend on it.
Can be set once onboarding has read the phone\'s own value.
Shorter and the motion check cannot finish.
Shorter and maintenance windows come too often.
Longer and messages could wait more than a day.
Each window grows by this much; outside 1 to 4 the gaps shrink or run away.
The profile is removed from this phone. Sessions recorded with it keep its name.
In use by the plan: choose another profile for that slot before deleting this one.
Counted from screen off; 0 is at once.
